checks.finding: Design Decisions gives a rationale for each decision: split suite placement (decision doc §3.1, INV-005), no ninth loop (shared quality-gate lifecycle), capability-only usage error, block_id adopted now, golden-baseline path (per-feature verification/ convention), and F7/F8 as N/A rather than SKIP. No unjustified decision found.

design.md '## Open Questions' entry OQ-004 ('open, carried forward') names no owner role. It has no 'Blocks Implementation: yes/no' field and no labelled 'Resolution Path:'. Its text names a resolution vehicle, but it is stated in the past tense and is then partly superseded by a '2026-10-05 amendment supersession (candidate)' paragraph saying 'OQ-004 closure remain pending'. requirements.md OQ-004 likewise names no owner. An implementer cannot tell who closes it or whether it gates the AC-009/AC-026/TEST-026 work. OQ-001 to OQ-003 are resolved, so they are fine.

investigation.md is present and the design cites INV-001 to INV-024 throughout. The Assumptions section defers to requirements.md and states the upstream-drift risk, which AC-035 fingerprint_match mitigates. The jq/bash/PowerShell runtime assumption is a reasonable default for this stack.

design.md has a '## Constraint Compliance' table. It covers the no-new-loop-entry, no-new-suite, assert_artifacts_schema/assert_terminal, emit-run-record byte-identical, REQ-007 SKIP, PROJECT_CONTEXT_INVALID, golden-baseline and cross-epic citation constraints. No constraint was found uncovered or contradicted.
No performance requirements found in requirements.md. It has no numeric latency, throughput or concurrency thresholds.

'## Deployment / CI Plan' fixes the registration targets: tests/run-all.sh and .ps1 and .github/workflows/test.yml. It states that CI runs only the read-only diff check and keeps the live-model refresh job non-gating. The test.yml protected-file staging precedent is noted. No schema change exists, so migration order does not apply, and no feature flag is needed.
The Data Plan states 'Data Entities: none persisted' and 'Existing Data Affected: none', with 'No migration required'. Every proposed change is additive and optional.
'## External Integrations' states 'None'. Every target is internal to the repository. Sibling-epic specs are cited only as fingerprinted read-only sources, with failure behaviour defined by AC-035.

Each design element maps to REQ-001 to REQ-007 and AC-001 to AC-043 (Cross-Layer Dependencies table). The three EXTRA items (promote script CI guard, AC-040/041, structural-fixture corpus) trace to REQ-006 and REQ-002/AC-030. Every Goal is covered, and no unrequested components were found. design-system/ is not applicable.

The high-risk surfaces have named verification. Golden-baseline integrity is covered by AC-040 (static test.yml scan) and AC-041 (runtime CI/--approved-by refusal fixtures). Shared-registry blast radius is covered by AC-008/AC-011. Upstream drift is covered by AC-035 hard-fails. The done-transition semantics are covered by TEST-026, with TEST-009 hash pinning.
SKIP: the launch-control observation reports domain/context-map.md and domain/domain-contract.json absent and domain_status 'skipped', so no Approved domain model exists.
